units.source: Content tabs
units.context: Content tabs

units.source: Content tabs group several titled panels of content into one block that shows a single panel at a time. They suit content that comes in variants (such as installation steps for each operating system or the same snippet in several programming languages).
units.context: Content tabs

units.source: A tabs block consists of:
units.context: Content tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__A single row of tab titles__TRILIUM_PH_1__, above the panel or, when the tabs are aligned at the bottom, below it. The title of the panel that is showing is highlighted.
units.context: Content tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__The panel of the active tab.__TRILIUM_PH_1__ A panel can hold any kind of content (including nested tabs blocks).
units.context: Content tabs

units.source: Inserting a tabs block__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Inserting a tabs block

units.source: In the formatting bar, go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Tabs__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Content tabs > Inserting a tabs block

units.source: Alternatively, type __TRILIUM_PH_0__ and press __TRILIUM_PH_1__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_2__, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_3__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_4__.
units.context: Content tabs > Inserting a tabs block

units.source: A new block contains two tabs, named “Tab 1” and “Tab 2”. Any content that was selected prior to inserting the tabs will be moved into the first tab. The title of the first tab is selected, so typing replaces it.
units.context: Content tabs > Inserting a tabs block

units.source: Scrolling through the titles__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Scrolling through the titles

units.source: When the titles of a block do not fit on their row, a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button and a __TRILIUM_PH_1__ button appear at its ends:
units.context: Content tabs > Scrolling through the titles

units.source: To scroll the titles, click one of the buttons. Holding a button down scrolls the titles continuously until it is released.
units.context: Content tabs > Scrolling through the titles

units.source: On a touch screen, the titles can also be swiped sideways.
units.context: Content tabs > Scrolling through the titles

units.source: Whenever another tab is shown (for example by clicking its title, by moving the cursor into it or by following a link to it), the row scrolls so that its whole title is visible. This works the same while editing, in read-only notes and on shared pages.
units.context: Content tabs > Scrolling through the titles

units.source: Editing tabs__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: To show a tab, click its title or move the cursor into it.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: To move from a title into its panel, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: The label of a tab can be formatted just like normal text, including support for __TRILIUM_PH_0__Icons__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: While the cursor is inside a tabs block, a toolbar appears above it with the following buttons:
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__(Add tab)__TRILIUM_PH_2__ inserts a tab after the current one and selects its title.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__(Remove tab)__TRILIUM_PH_2__ removes the current tab. Removing the last tab removes the whole block.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__(Move tab left)__TRILIUM_PH_2__ and __TRILIUM_PH_3__ (__TRILIUM_PH_4__Move tab right)__TRILIUM_PH_5__ change the order of the tabs.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__(More actions)__TRILIUM_PH_2__ opens a menu with the actions of the toolbar and a few more.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu has the following entries:
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Add new tab__TRILIUM_PH_1__ inserts a tab after the current one, like the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Copy reference to this tab__TRILIUM_PH_1__ copies a link to the current tab, as described below.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Move tab right__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Move tab left__TRILIUM_PH_3__ change the order of the tabs.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Tab alignment__TRILIUM_PH_1__ places the tab titles above the panel (__TRILIUM_PH_2__Align tabs at top__TRILIUM_PH_3__, the default) or below it (__TRILIUM_PH_4__Align tabs at bottom__TRILIUM_PH_5__).
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Delete tab__TRILIUM_PH_1__ removes the current tab, like the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Delete all tabs__TRILIUM_PH_1__ removes the whole tabs block and leaves an empty paragraph in its place. In a tabs block nested inside another, only the inner block is removed.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: The tab that is showing is not saved with the note: every tabs block opens on its first tab.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs

units.source: Adding tabs__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Adding tabs

units.source: While the cursor is in a tab, either in its title or in its panel, you can use these key combinations:
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Adding tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_3__: Add a tab after the current one.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Adding tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__: Add a tab before the current one.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Adding tabs

units.source: The new tab is shown and its title is selected, so typing replaces it.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Adding tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_3__ keeps its usual function on a link, in a to-do item and in the title of a collapsible block, and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__ + __TRILIUM_PH_6__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_7__ + __TRILIUM_PH_8__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in a to-do item.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Adding tabs

units.source: Reordering tabs__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Reordering tabs

units.source: While the cursor is in a tab, either in its title or in its panel, you can use these key combinations:
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Reordering tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__Right__TRILIUM_PH_5__: Move the tab to the right.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Reordering tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__Left__TRILIUM_PH_5__: Move the tab to the left.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Reordering tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__Home__TRILIUM_PH_5__: Make it the first tab.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Reordering tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__End__TRILIUM_PH_5__: Make it the last tab.
units.context: Content tabs > Editing tabs > Reordering tabs

units.source: Moving content between tabs__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: To move content to another tab, select it in the panel, and then use these key combinations:
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Right__TRILIUM_PH_3__: Move to the tab on the right.
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Left__TRILIUM_PH_3__: Move to the tab on the left.
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__End__TRILIUM_PH_5__: Move to the last tab.
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__ + __TRILIUM_PH_4__Home__TRILIUM_PH_5__: Move to the first tab.
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: The tab that receives the content is shown, with the content still selected, so pressing the key again moves it on to the next tab. Paragraphs, list items, tables and other blocks move whole, even when only part of them is selected. Content moved to a tab on the left goes to the end of that tab, and content moved to a tab on the right goes to its start, so it keeps its place in the reading order.
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: Without a selection, or with a selection in a tab title, these keys keep their usual function: moving the cursor by word, or selecting up to the start or end of the tab.
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: When a tabs block and a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Multicolumn layout__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are nested in one another, the key combinations act on the one closest to the cursor.
units.context: Content tabs > Moving content between tabs

units.source: Reading tabs__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Reading tabs

units.source: In __TRILIUM_PH_0__Read-Only Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and on __TRILIUM_PH_2__Sharing__TRILIUM_PH_3__, tabs blocks work as tabs as well:
units.context: Content tabs > Reading tabs

units.source: To show a tab, click its title, or focus it and press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Space__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Content tabs > Reading tabs

units.source: To move between the titles of a block, use the arrow keys, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Home__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__End__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Content tabs > Reading tabs

units.source: A tab without a title shows “Tab title” in place of one.
units.context: Content tabs > Reading tabs

units.source: In read-only notes, a title too long for its tab fades out where it is cut off. To read the rest of it, swipe it sideways or drag it with the mouse.
units.context: Content tabs > Reading tabs

units.source: Linking to a tab__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Linking to a tab

units.source: A link can point to a single tab, much like a link to a block (see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Block references__TRILIUM_PH_1__):
units.context: Content tabs > Linking to a tab

units.source: Place the cursor in the tab, either in its title or in its panel.
units.context: Content tabs > Linking to a tab

units.source: In the toolbar of the tabs block, open the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu and select __TRILIUM_PH_3__Copy reference to this tab__TRILIUM_PH_4__. Alternatively, right-click the text and select __TRILIUM_PH_5__Copy__TRILIUM_PH_6__ → __TRILIUM_PH_7__Copy link to this tab__TRILIUM_PH_8__. The tab flashes briefly.
units.context: Content tabs > Linking to a tab

units.source: Go to the note where to insert the link and press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__V__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Content tabs > Linking to a tab

units.source: The link shows the title of the note, followed by the title of the tab. Clicking it opens the note, shows the tab and flashes it. As with any block reference, the link can be turned into an __TRILIUM_PH_0__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ that shows only that tab.
units.context: Content tabs > Linking to a tab

units.source: Links to a tab can be copied only from a note being edited. On a __TRILIUM_PH_0__shared page__TRILIUM_PH_1__, such a link opens the whole note.
units.context: Content tabs > Linking to a tab

units.source: Content in hidden tabs__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Content in hidden tabs

units.source: Content inside a tab that is not showing is still reachable (both while editing and while reading). The tab that holds it is shown when:
units.context: Content tabs > Content in hidden tabs

units.source: searching the note with __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__F__TRILIUM_PH_3__ highlights a match inside it;
units.context: Content tabs > Content in hidden tabs

units.source: a link points to an anchor or a block inside it (see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Anchors__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Block references__TRILIUM_PH_3__);
units.context: Content tabs > Content in hidden tabs

units.source: an entry of the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Table of contents__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Highlights list__TRILIUM_PH_3__ points inside it;
units.context: Content tabs > Content in hidden tabs

units.source: on a shared page, the address of the page points to a heading or an anchor inside it.
units.context: Content tabs > Content in hidden tabs

units.source: Tab titles are not headings, so they do not appear in the table of contents; headings inside a panel do.
units.context: Content tabs > Content in hidden tabs

units.source: Printing and exporting__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content tabs > Printing and exporting

units.source: When printing or __TRILIUM_PH_0__exporting to PDF__TRILIUM_PH_1__, every tab is printed, one after another, each with its title above its panel, whatever the tab alignment.
units.context: Content tabs > Printing and exporting

units.source: Markdown export and import write tabs blocks in the content tabs syntax of Material for MkDocs, described in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Supported syntax__TRILIUM_PH_1__. __TRILIUM_PH_2__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_3__ notes use the same syntax, show the blocks as tabs in their preview and insert them with __TRILIUM_PH_4__. That syntax has no tab alignment, so tabs aligned at the bottom are exported as regular tabs.
units.context: Content tabs > Printing and exporting

units.source: Anywhere the tabs cannot work as tabs (such as an HTML export opened elsewhere), a tabs block reads as a sequence of titled sections.
units.context: Content tabs > Printing and exporting
